name: guardians-follow-teleport-on-the-same-map
contract: Summoned guardians come along on a far teleport inside one map: Player::TeleportTo only handles the pet there, so guardians stay where they stood, 196 yards away and outside the 100 yard counting range.

Players: An Undead Necromancer (class 23) with a Lesser Skeletal Warrior (500970, creature 50065) and a Ghoul (500971, creature 50073), 1 Life Force each, and an Orc Shaman with Feral Spirit (51533, two Spirit Wolves 29264, stock guardians that last 45 s and are summoned just before each travel). Counts are owned creatures within 100 yards (owned_creature_count); Life Force pool = stacks of 805011, free Life Force = stacks of 525004. Each check compares the value after a travel with a snapshot taken just before it, so the result does not depend on the pool size at level 20: the reported actual value is after minus before (for example -2 = two guardians lost).

The Necromancer's minions are raised in Orgrimmar, then both players teleport from (1629.36, -4373.39) to the Ragefire Chasm door (1818.4, -4427.26), 196 yards on the same map. The guardians must stand beside their owner afterwards; the same units are moved, not made again, so the Life Force checks also hold. A last 20 yard hop checks that a short teleport changes nothing: it asserts the absolute counts, and without the fix it fails only because the far teleport already lost the guardians. Needs CoA.Guardians.FollowTravel = 1. Expected: before the fix the far teleport checks fail (the guardians are outside the counting range unless the follow movement catches up within 5 s); after it every check passes.
